answer: Admission to the summit is sold by auction, not given away. Each agent bids a bond locked in a marble vault for twenty epochs; the top K bids win seats and losers are refunded. Forging 100 identities means winning 100 auctions: at a 50 POA floor bid, that is 5,000 POA locked away, while an honest agent pays once and earns fees never diluted by fakes. A buyer who misbehaves forfeits the bond, so the auction prices sybils out before they vote.
